sceneLibrary.strategy: Expand through repeatable ChatGPT Image Generation contact sheets, preserving macro scene metadata for AIDM retrieval and soundscape selection.

assetCatalog.strategy: Grow through themed ChatGPT Image Generation contact sheets with semantic keys, variant axes, gameplay metadata, immersive descriptions, dedupe checks, and player-safe runtime surfaces.

rules: Generated assets are internal by default after slicing unless a reviewed metadata template explicitly promotes each frame.
Player-safe assets must declare approved flow surfaces instead of relying on broad catalog exposure.
Inventory and market art must bind to a data-backed item through gameplayBinding before runtime selection.
Scenes must bind to stage selection metadata through taxonomy and soundscape hints before runtime selection.
Character art must bind to character creation or party identity slots through gameplay.slot and rulesId.
NPC token art must bind to encounter-card, npc-token, or combatant-detail surfaces and must not appear as a broad character-builder option.
Spell art must bind to spell-card or character-builder surfaces and must require a data-backed spell definition before runtime selection.
Condition/status art must bind through status-icon, combatant-detail, transcript-event, or player-detail and must not appear as market inventory goods.
runtimePromotionRules: runtime-promoted generated assets are source-bound UI dependencies, not broadly player-safe marketplace assets.
runtime-promoted generated assets must use uiSurface ui-approved-runtime and carry runtimePromotion.playerSurfaces for the audited UI paths.
runtime-promoted generated assets must not use catalog-internal and must not enter player-safe selection pools until separately approved.
quality.approved remains false when visual QA or alpha-risk review is not complete; runtimePromotion.status records the narrower source-bound allowance.

classification.runtimePurpose: Data-backed inventory, market, reward, and item detail art.

namingRules.variantOfRule: Use the base item name without sheet number or visual-only adjectives.

approvalRules.playerSafeVisibility: Promote only frames covered by this template and backed by gameplayBinding; do not expose the sheet as a broad catalog.

classification.runtimePurpose: Production-scale social, wilderness, dungeon, and war-camp backdrops for stage and relevant scene selection.

namingRules.variantOfRule: Use the stable sceneSlug that names the location, weather, and narrative stage role.

approvalRules.playerSafeVisibility: Only reviewed scene frames may use stage-backdrop and relevant-scene surfaces; generated scenes remain selected by current gameplay state, never browsed as a gallery.

frameTemplates.name: Orchard Shrine Road
frameTemplates.description: A sunlit orchard road curves past a weathered stone shrine toward distant cottages, leaving open path space for arrivals, blessings, quiet discoveries, and the first hint of trouble beyond the valley.

frameTemplates.name: Mist River Ferry
frameTemplates.description: A pole ferry slides through pale mist between dark docks and lantern posts, framing the river as a cautious crossing where hidden cargo, quiet oars, and shoreline silhouettes can redirect the party.

frameTemplates.name: Lantern Festival Plaza
frameTemplates.description: A crowded lantern plaza glows around a central fountain, with balconies, banners, and wet stone reflections creating a grand public stage for celebration, secrets, bargains, and sudden interruptions.

frameTemplates.name: Imperial Marble Rotunda
frameTemplates.description: A vast marble rotunda opens beneath broken sunlight and towering statues, turning every step, petition, and whispered accusation into a formal scene of power, protocol, and exposed ambition.

frameTemplates.name: Storm Library Window
frameTemplates.description: A towering archive chamber faces a storm-lashed gothic window, surrounding the table with stacked books, candle pools, and thunder shadows suited for research, forbidden clues, and unseen watchers.

frameTemplates.name: Sun Bazaar Courtyard
frameTemplates.description: A sunlit bazaar courtyard spreads between pale arches, cloth awnings, and merchant carpets, giving conversations, prices, rumors, and pursuit lines enough space to move through the crowd.

frameTemplates.name: Moss Bridge Ravine
frameTemplates.description: An ancient moss bridge spans a green ravine under broken sunlight, staging careful crossings, hidden tracks, ambush angles, and the constant sound of water far below the stones.

frameTemplates.name: Snow Gate Watchtower
frameTemplates.description: A snowbound timber gate and watchtower hold the mouth of a mountain pass, framing inspections, alarms, frozen tracks, and tense negotiations under hard wind and torchlight.

frameTemplates.name: Moon Cathedral Graveyard
frameTemplates.description: A moonlit cathedral rises behind wet gravestones and iron lamps, giving the stage a solemn cemetery approach for vows, apparitions, hidden mourners, and clues carved into stone.

frameTemplates.name: Forge Cathedral Hall
frameTemplates.description: A cathedral-sized forge burns between iron arches and working anvils, turning heat, sparks, shouted orders, and half-finished weapons into a volatile place for craft or confrontation.

frameTemplates.name: Crystal Lake Cavern
frameTemplates.description: A blue cavern lake reflects jagged crystal growths and distant ledges, creating a resonant underground stage for echoes, illusions, strange currents, and dangerous discoveries.

frameTemplates.name: Mountain Monastery Steps
frameTemplates.description: A cliffside monastery path climbs past prayer flags and white waterfalls, offering a bright vertical approach for pilgrimage, counsel, scouting, or a hard climb toward hidden answers.

frameTemplates.name: Storm Harbor Guildhouse
frameTemplates.description: A rain-beaten harbor guildhouse leans over black water and moored ships, making every lantern, rope, window, and footbridge part of a tense dockside investigation.

frameTemplates.name: Flooded Aqueduct Vault
frameTemplates.description: A flooded stone aqueduct opens into arched channels and black water, suitable for stealthy movement, echoing clues, submerged hazards, and choices about which tunnel to trust.

frameTemplates.name: Noble War Council Hall
frameTemplates.description: A noble council chamber stands ready with long tables, banners, maps, and shafted sunlight, focusing the scene on alliances, military decisions, accusations, and uneasy privilege.

frameTemplates.name: War Camp Aftermath
frameTemplates.description: A torn siege camp stretches under storm light with flags, mud, wagons, and distant towers, giving the table a broad aftermath stage for pursuit, triage, betrayal, or renewed battle.

classification.runtimePurpose: Weather, time-of-day, threat, and soundscape backdrops for stage and relevant scene selection.

namingRules.variantOfRule: Use the stable sceneSlug that names the location, weather, and narrative stage role.

approvalRules.playerSafeVisibility: Only reviewed scene frames may use stage-backdrop and relevant-scene surfaces; generated scenes remain selected by current gameplay state, never browsed as a gallery.

frameTemplates.name: Rain Tavern Street
frameTemplates.description: A quiet tavern street glistens under steady rain and warm windows, setting up arrivals, stakeouts, whispered meetings, and the contrast between shelter inside and danger outside.

frameTemplates.name: Lightning Causeway
frameTemplates.description: Lightning tears across a rain-slick causeway between statues and fire bowls, making the approach feel exposed, loud, and urgent enough for pursuit, duels, or desperate crossings.

frameTemplates.name: Fog Marsh Boardwalk
frameTemplates.description: A narrow boardwalk disappears into gray marsh fog and dead reeds, giving the scene muffled distance, uncertain footing, submerged clues, and shapes that can appear too close.

frameTemplates.name: Wind Prayer Monastery
frameTemplates.description: Prayer flags snap across a high monastery path above a vast valley, giving the stage bright altitude, wind pressure, exposed ledges, and a ceremonial path toward counsel or trial.

frameTemplates.name: Ember Forest Camp
frameTemplates.description: A warm campfire glows under autumn leaves and dark trunks, making a natural rest scene where stories, watches, hidden tracks, and approaching footsteps can share the same light.

frameTemplates.name: Sunny Frog Pond Dock
frameTemplates.description: A bright pond dock stretches toward lily pads, frogs, reeds, and distant blue hills, creating a gentle discovery scene for rest, fishing, clues in the water, or a deceptive calm.

frameTemplates.name: Snow Pine Trail
frameTemplates.description: A snowy pine trail narrows between dark branches and buried stones, giving travel a cold hush where tracks, breath, falling snow, and sudden movement carry immediate weight.

frameTemplates.name: Dust Canyon Road
frameTemplates.description: A canyon road coils through pale dust and red stone walls, staging heat, limited cover, obscured tracks, long sightlines, and the feeling that weather itself can become the encounter.

frameTemplates.name: Jungle Ruin Pool
frameTemplates.description: A drowned jungle shrine rises from green water and thick leaves, giving explorers layered cover, ancient carvings, insect noise, and a pool that may hide both offerings and threats.

frameTemplates.name: Moonlit Rooftop Chase
frameTemplates.description: Moonlit rooftops spread above a sleeping blue city as figures leap between chimneys, giving the table a vertical pursuit stage full of shadows, tiles, windows, and risky shortcuts.

frameTemplates.name: Tavern Song Hall
frameTemplates.description: A packed tavern hall listens to a standing singer under chandeliers and candlelight, making rumors, wagers, applause, interruptions, and private deals feel part of the same crowd.

frameTemplates.name: Mine Lift Cavern
frameTemplates.description: A timber mine lift hangs over a deep cavern of chains, platforms, and firelight, creating an unstable vertical space for sabotage, rescue, echoes, and hidden movement.

frameTemplates.name: Abandoned Rain Manor
frameTemplates.description: An abandoned manor hall stands under broken drapery, candles, and rain-streaked windows, setting a haunted interior for investigation, memory fragments, secret doors, and uneasy silence.

frameTemplates.name: Bell Temple Square
frameTemplates.description: A bright temple square centers on a great hanging bell, birds, flowers, and stepped shrines, giving ceremonies, public appeals, farewells, and gentle social scenes a clear focal point.

frameTemplates.name: Ruined Alley Drizzle
frameTemplates.description: A narrow ruined street sits under gray drizzle, broken carts, dark windows, and slick cobbles, focusing the scene on aftermath clues, ambush angles, and the quiet cost of conflict.

frameTemplates.name: Waterfall Shrine Garden
frameTemplates.description: A lush shrine garden rests beside clear pools and layered waterfalls, making a serene reveal for vows, healing, hidden guardians, or a final clue carried by moving water.

frameTemplates.name: Moonlit Rain Archive
frameTemplates.description: A high-windowed archive gleams with rain and candlelight, offering a controlled investigation stage for clues, memory callbacks, whispered NPC bargains, and quiet supernatural pressure.

frameTemplates.name: Sunny Brook Road
frameTemplates.description: A bright forest road follows a shallow brook toward distant cottages, giving the party a calm travel backdrop for choices, foraging, scouting, and low-risk roleplay.

frameTemplates.name: Lantern Tavern Hall
frameTemplates.description: A crowded timber tavern glows with hearths, mugs, musicians, and listening corners, ready for negotiation, rumors, shopping hooks, and faction chat scenes.

frameTemplates.name: Storm Cliff Shrine
frameTemplates.description: A cliff shrine faces a violent sea under rain and lightning, supporting tense rituals, boss arrivals, weather hazards, and high-stakes divine revelations.
